subtopics.label: Obesity Pharmacotherapy and Weight Management Interventions
subtopics.description: Research on pharmacological, surgical, and behavioral interventions for obesity and weight management, including GLP-1 receptor agonists (semaglutide, tirzepatide, liraglutide), bariatric surgery outcomes, anti-obesity medications, and long-term weight loss maintenance strategies.
subtopics.short_description: Pharmacological, surgical, and behavioral interventions for obesity, including GLP-1 agonists, bariatric surgery, and long-term weight loss strategies.

subtopics.label: Dietary Patterns, Food Environment, and Nutritional Epidemiology
subtopics.description: Epidemiological studies examining dietary patterns, food quality, food environment, and their associations with chronic disease risk including cardiovascular disease, diabetes, and cancer, encompassing population-based cohorts and dietary assessment methodologies.
subtopics.short_description: Population-based studies linking dietary patterns, food quality, and food environment to chronic disease risk including cardiovascular disease and diabetes.

subtopics.label: Metabolomics, Proteomics, and Multi-Omics Profiling
subtopics.description: Studies employing metabolomics, proteomics, and integrated multi-omics approaches to characterize metabolic signatures of disease states, drug responses, and physiological conditions, including development of computational tools and pipelines for omics data analysis.
subtopics.short_description: Integrated metabolomic, proteomic, and multi-omics approaches to characterize metabolic signatures of disease, drug response, and physiological conditions.

subtopics.label: Lipid Metabolism, Adipose Biology, and Adipogenesis
subtopics.description: Research on lipid metabolic pathways, adipocyte biology, adipogenesis, and adipose tissue function including fatty acid oxidation, de novo lipogenesis, adipokines, thermogenesis, and the molecular regulation of fat storage and mobilization.
subtopics.short_description: Lipid metabolic pathways, adipocyte biology, adipogenesis, and molecular regulation of fat storage, mobilization, and thermogenesis.

subtopics.label: NAD+ Metabolism, Mitochondrial Function, and Cellular Bioenergetics
subtopics.description: Research on NAD+/NADH biosynthesis, salvage pathways, and precursors (NMN, NRH, NR), mitochondrial oxidative phosphorylation, and cellular energy metabolism, including their roles in metabolic disease, aging, and therapeutic interventions.
subtopics.short_description: NAD+/NADH biosynthesis, mitochondrial oxidative phosphorylation, and cellular energy metabolism in metabolic disease, aging, and therapeutic contexts.

subtopics.label: Glucose Homeostasis, Insulin Signaling, and Type 2 Diabetes
subtopics.description: Studies on glucose metabolism, insulin secretion and resistance, beta-cell function, and type 2 diabetes pathophysiology, including molecular mechanisms of glucose transport, glycemic control interventions, and epidemiological modeling of diabetes burden.
subtopics.short_description: Insulin secretion, insulin resistance, beta-cell function, and molecular mechanisms of glucose transport underlying type 2 diabetes pathophysiology.

subtopics.label: Cancer Metabolism and Metabolic Reprogramming in Tumors
subtopics.description: Research on metabolic alterations in cancer cells and the tumor microenvironment, including Warburg effect, lipid biosynthesis, oncometabolites, and how metabolic reprogramming drives tumor progression, metastasis, and therapeutic resistance.
subtopics.short_description: Metabolic alterations in cancer cells, including Warburg effect, lipid biosynthesis, and oncometabolites driving tumor progression and therapeutic resistance.

subtopics.label: Gut Microbiome, Dietary Fiber, and Host Metabolism
subtopics.description: Research on interactions between dietary components (fiber, fermentable carbohydrates, amino acids) and gut microbiota, and their downstream effects on host metabolism, immunity, bile acid signaling, and disease outcomes.
subtopics.short_description: Interactions between dietary fiber, fermentable carbohydrates, and gut microbiota affecting host metabolism, immunity, and bile acid signaling.

subtopics.label: Vitamins, Micronutrients, and Mineral Metabolism
subtopics.description: Studies on the roles of vitamins (D, B12, A/retinoids, K), minerals (iron, phosphate, magnesium, zinc, copper), and other micronutrients in metabolic health, disease prevention, and clinical outcomes, including deficiency states and supplementation trials.
subtopics.short_description: Roles of vitamins, minerals, and micronutrients in metabolic health, disease prevention, deficiency states, and clinical supplementation outcomes.

subtopics.label: Sphingolipid and Ceramide Metabolism in Cardiometabolic Disease
subtopics.description: Research on sphingolipid biosynthesis, ceramide and sphingosine-1-phosphate signaling, and their roles in cardiovascular disease, atherosclerosis, and metabolic dysfunction, including endothelial sphingolipid homeostasis and therapeutic targeting.
subtopics.short_description: Sphingolipid biosynthesis, ceramide and sphingosine-1-phosphate signaling, and their roles in cardiovascular disease and cardiometabolic dysfunction.

subtopics.label: Alcohol-Associated Liver Disease, NAFLD, and Hepatic Metabolism
subtopics.description: Research on metabolic mechanisms underlying alcohol-associated liver disease and non-alcoholic fatty liver disease, including retinoid metabolism, hepatic steatosis, lipid accumulation, and therapeutic interventions targeting liver metabolic pathways.
subtopics.short_description: Metabolic mechanisms of alcohol-associated liver disease and NAFLD, including retinoid metabolism, hepatic steatosis, and therapeutic targeting.

subtopics.label: Dietary Interventions and Nutritional Strategies for Chronic Disease Prevention
subtopics.description: Clinical and translational studies evaluating specific dietary interventions—including ketogenic diets, Mediterranean diet, omega-3 fatty acids, carotenoids, and caloric restriction—for prevention or management of chronic diseases such as Alzheimer's disease, cardiovascular disease, and cancer.
subtopics.short_description: Clinical and translational studies of ketogenic, Mediterranean, and caloric-restriction diets for prevention of Alzheimer's disease, cardiovascular disease, and cancer.

subtopics.label: Mycobacterium tuberculosis Metabolic Pathways and Nutritional Vulnerabilities
subtopics.description: Research on the metabolic physiology of Mycobacterium tuberculosis, including carbon and nitrogen metabolism, fatty acid oxidation, NAD/NADP biosynthesis, lipid assimilation, and identification of metabolic vulnerabilities as drug targets.
subtopics.short_description: Carbon and nitrogen metabolism, fatty acid oxidation, and NAD biosynthesis in M. tuberculosis as targets for novel drug development.

subtopics.label: Metabolic Syndrome, Cardiometabolic Risk, and Obesity-Related Comorbidities
subtopics.description: Studies on metabolic syndrome components, cardiometabolic risk factors, and obesity-related comorbidities including hypertension, dyslipidemia, peripheral neuropathy, and cardiovascular outcomes, with emphasis on epidemiological associations and clinical management.
subtopics.short_description: Epidemiological and clinical studies of metabolic syndrome components, dyslipidemia, hypertension, and obesity-related cardiovascular comorbidities.

subtopics.label: Obesity, Weight Management, and Nutritional Interventions in Cancer Survivors
subtopics.description: Research on weight management programs, dietary interventions, and body composition changes in cancer survivors, including behavioral and remote-based approaches to reduce obesity-related cancer recurrence risk.
subtopics.short_description: Dietary and behavioral interventions targeting obesity and body composition in cancer survivors to reduce recurrence risk.

subtopics.label: Renal Electrolyte Transport, Potassium, and Sodium Homeostasis
subtopics.description: Studies examining kidney tubular mechanisms regulating sodium and potassium excretion, including ENaC, ROMK channels, aldosterone signaling, and dietary potassium effects on proximal tubule transport.
subtopics.short_description: Kidney tubular mechanisms regulating sodium and potassium excretion, including ENaC, ROMK channels, and dietary potassium effects on transport.

subtopics.label: Immune Cell Metabolism, T Cell Function, and Immunotherapy
subtopics.description: Research on metabolic reprogramming in immune cells—particularly T cells and dendritic cells—and how nutrient availability, lipid oxidation, and glycolytic pathways influence antitumor immunity and immunotherapy efficacy.
subtopics.short_description: Metabolic reprogramming in T cells and dendritic cells, and how nutrient availability and glycolytic pathways influence immunotherapy efficacy.

subtopics.label: COVID-19, Metabolic Dysregulation, and Nutritional Status
subtopics.description: Studies investigating metabolic and nutritional aspects of COVID-19, including hyperglycemia, insulin resistance, adipose tissue infectivity, multi-omics signatures of disease severity, and albumin kinetics in critically ill patients.
subtopics.short_description: Metabolic and nutritional aspects of COVID-19, including hyperglycemia, insulin resistance, adipose infectivity, and multi-omics signatures of disease severity.

subtopics.label: Breast Tissue Composition, Adiposity, and Cancer Risk Biomarkers
subtopics.description: Research examining how body fat, adiposity measures, alcohol consumption, and hormonal factors influence breast tissue composition, mammographic features, and breast cancer risk.
subtopics.short_description: Adiposity, hormonal factors, and alcohol consumption as determinants of breast tissue composition, mammographic features, and cancer risk biomarkers.

subtopics.label: mTOR Signaling, Lysosomal Nutrient Sensing, and Autophagy
subtopics.description: Studies on nutrient-sensing pathways including mTORC1 regulation by Rap1-GTPases, lysosomal catabolism controlled by phosphoinositide switches, and SAM dynamics as metabolic signals in mammalian cells.
subtopics.short_description: Nutrient-sensing via mTORC1, lysosomal catabolism, phosphoinositide switches, and SAM dynamics as metabolic signals in mammalian cells.

subtopics.label: Neurological Disorders, Brain Metabolism, and Glucose Utilization
subtopics.description: Studies on metabolic underpinnings of neurological conditions including Glut1 deficiency syndrome, Alzheimer's disease succinylation, adenosine deficiency in AD, and triglyceride utilization at synapses.
subtopics.short_description: Metabolic underpinnings of neurological conditions including Glut1 deficiency, Alzheimer's disease succinylation, and synaptic triglyceride utilization.

subtopics.label: Obesity Disparities, Behavioral Determinants, and Community Interventions
subtopics.description: Research addressing racial, ethnic, and socioeconomic disparities in obesity prevalence and management, including behavioral determinants of eating, community-based interventions, and culturally tailored weight loss programs.
subtopics.short_description: Racial, ethnic, and socioeconomic disparities in obesity prevalence, behavioral determinants of eating, and culturally tailored community-based programs.

subtopics.label: Hepatic Gene Expression, Dietary Carbohydrates, and Fasting-Feeding Regulation
subtopics.description: Studies examining how dietary composition and fasting-feeding cycles regulate liver gene expression and transcriptomic responses, including strain-specific differences in mouse models.
subtopics.short_description: Fasting-feeding cycles and dietary carbohydrate composition as regulators of liver transcriptomic responses and gene expression.

subtopics.label: Pediatric and Neonatal Nutrition, Infant Feeding, and Early-Life Metabolic Health
subtopics.description: Studies on nutritional interventions and feeding practices in neonates and children, including lactoferrin supplementation in preterm infants, dextrose gel for neonatal hypoglycemia, breastfeeding practices, and gestational diabetes outcomes.
subtopics.short_description: Feeding practices and nutritional interventions in neonates and children, including lactoferrin supplementation, neonatal hypoglycemia, and gestational diabetes outcomes.

subtopics.label: Adipokines, FGF Signaling, and Cardiometabolic Organ Crosstalk
subtopics.description: Research on adipokine and fibroblast growth factor signaling between adipose tissue and other organs, including FGF21 in metabolic regulation, FGF23/FGFR4 in cardiac remodeling, pancreatic islet responses to adipokines, and NOV silencing in cardiometabolic dysfunction.
subtopics.short_description: Adipokine and fibroblast growth factor signaling between adipose tissue and heart, pancreas, and kidney in cardiometabolic regulation and dysfunction.

subtopics.label: Tryptophan, Kynurenine, and Amino Acid Metabolic Pathways in Disease
subtopics.description: Studies on tryptophan catabolism and related amino acid pathways, including kynurenamine immunomodulation, transsulfuration pathway alterations in ALS, and homoarginine effects on amino acid homeostasis.
subtopics.short_description: Tryptophan catabolism, kynurenamine immunomodulation, transsulfuration pathway alterations in ALS, and homoarginine effects on amino acid homeostasis.
